link.description:
Land carnivores are the bearers of sharp teeth and claws. The tearers of flesh. The instruments of natural selection. The ones that cull the weak, the sick and the old.
But they are far from villains. Through carnivores, nature keeps its health. By killing off herbivores, they keep their populations in balance and prevent sickness from spreading. The awesome hunters of the Garden are a living indicator of its splendour.
